$comment: Pinned SHA-256 hashes of the normative JSON Schemas that govern the HelloCamera phone-client wire contract. A companion implementation MUST pin these exact schema versions. The executable kit (tests/test_conformance_kit.py) re-computes these hashes from docs/protocol-v{1,2}.schema.json on every run, so editing a schema without re-freezing it here fails the kit. Hashes cover the file bytes as committed (UTF-8, no trailing newline normalization). The landing commit on v1.0.0 is recorded by git history; this file pins bytes, not a commit SHA.

schemas.name: protocol-v1
schemas.governs: Closed v1 camera transport: hello, observation, preview/high-resolution image headers, capture request, client errors, and result/result_image ordering. Negotiated v2 rides the same endpoint and binary envelope.

schemas.name: protocol-v2
schemas.governs: V2 interaction extension: protocol_v2_offer, protocol_v2_accept, coaching_state_v2, user_action_v2, action_result_v2, protocol_error_v2, and the visual_guidance_image_v2 binary header.
